name: Merkato
subtitle: Merkato is an open-air market in western Addis Ababa, described in academic sources as the largest open market in Africa.

facts.label: Italian-era relocation
facts.value: The existing market was moved to the north-western part of town

parts.text: Merkato is an open-air market in western Addis Ababa, described in academic sources as the largest open market in Africa. Its present form dates to the Italian occupation, when it was named for the 'indigenous' population.
